course.title: Civil Engineering MEng | Imperial College London
quotes: Qualification MEng Duration 4 years Start date October 2027 UCAS course code H201
Delivered by Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

Minimum entry standard A*A*A or A*AAA To include: A* in Mathematics A/A* in Physics (A* is required if applying with three A-levels. At least an A is required if applying with four A-levels) A in a third/fourth subject
Minimum entry standard 40 points To include: 7 in Mathematics at higher level 6 in Physics at higher level

EITHER 5, 5, 5, 5, 5 to include Calculus BC and Physics C (Mechanics) or Physics C (Electricity and Magnetism) OR 5, 5, 5 to include Calculus BC and Physics C (Mechanics) or Physics C (Electricity and Magnetism) Award of acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g., US High School Diploma) Either 1480 in SAT or 33 in ACT.
Our minimum entry standard is 92% overall, to include: 95% in Mathematics 95% / 90% including Physics
Our minimum entry standard is 1.4 overall, to include the following abiturprufung exams: 14 in Mathematics 14 in Physics
To be eligible for selection for this course, you will need to sit three ESAT modules: Mathematics 1 Mathematics 2 Physics
Applicants who have the potential to meet the minimum entry requirements are invited to make an online video submission.
you must achieve the standard university requirement
Application deadlines - Wednesday 13 January 2027 at 18.00 (UK time)
